components.html:
GitHub fixture: checks en workflows

Reads the most recent Actions runs, opens the newest one with its jobs, tails the log of its first job, and reports whether its commit is green. Needs a repository that has Actions history — with none, the first step returns nothing and the steps after it have no run to read. Re-running is off by default, because it costs a build.

  1. Workflow-runs opsommen
  2. Workflow-run ophalen
  3. Joblogboek ophalen
  4. Checkstatus ophalen
  5. Workflow opnieuw uitvoeren

components.label: Repository
components.description: Must be a repository the token of the plugin configuration may reach. Fill it in even when the configuration has a default — the fixtures build search queries and REST paths out of it.

components.label: Gefaalde jobs opnieuw uitvoeren
